params.caption: 🏆 FURIA crush Spirit to win BLAST Rivals in Hong Kong FURIA are BLAST Rivals champions after a dominant grand final win over Team Spirit in Hong Kong. It's their third trophy in their last four events, a late-season surge that keeps FalleN's farewell run going in style. The Brazilians got there by sweeping Falcons in the semis, after handing Vitality a 13-0 map in the quarters. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 14:11 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV 👥 @BLASTPremier 🏆 React if FURIA are your Major favourite · 💬 Can anyone stop them? #CS2 #FURIA #BLASTRivals #TeamSpirit #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
